blocks.text: To edit a configured Private Cloud Controller group:

blocks.item: Go to Infrastructure > Private Access > Business Continuity > Private Cloud Controller Groups.
Locate the Private Cloud Controller group you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.
Private Cloud Controller groups that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited. To learn more, see Understanding Zscaler-Managed Business Continuity Cloud.

blocks.text: The Edit Private Cloud Controller Group page appears.

blocks.item: On the Edit Private Cloud Controller Group page, you can modify any field.
